from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal, List, Optional

class CaseDocument(BaseModel):
    """Represents a single legal judgment document with its classification."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The title or name of the judgment document")
    matched_category: Optional[Literal[
        "行政行为 - 行政强制",
        "贪污受贿罪",
        "行政行为 - 行政征收",
        "执行案由 - 其他案由",
        "行政行为 - 行政裁决",
        "产品责任纠纷",
        "执行案由 - 行政非诉执行",
        "行政主体 - 行政检查（监察）",
        "刑事赔偿",
        "危害公共安全罪",
        "妨碍社会管理秩序罪",
        "行政主体 - 民政行政管理（民政）",
        "海事海商纠纷",
        "执行案由 - 对下级法院执行异议裁定的复议",
        "破坏社会主义市场经济秩序罪",
        "非刑事赔偿 - 错误执行赔偿",
        "执行案由 - 民事",
        "行政主体 - 司法行政管理（司法行政）"
    ]] = Field(description="The specific legal category this document belongs to, matched from the provided list")
    key_legal_elements: str | None = Field(description="Specific legal elements mentioned in the document that justify the classification, e.g., crime name, administrative act, dispute type")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Container for all extracted documents from the input collection."""
    documents: List[CaseDocument]
